Bidder should submit a bank mandate populated with their Bank Account details duly signed by branch manager. 9. Bidder should submit the detailed working structure plan along with the site-specific (of light fixtu res and exhaust fans for Proposed Eco-Tourism at Kiriburu, including 50/60W LED flood ligh ts (IP66), recessed/surface mounted LED round/square downlights (6W to 20W), 1'x1' and 2 'x2' LED panel lights, surface mounted LED tube lights (10W to 22W), 20/25W LED post top lamps, LED bollard fittings (8/9W, IP65), ceiling fan numbering, 24V DC LED strip lights (5W /m), LED mirror lights (8/10W), 1200mm BLDC 5-star ceiling fans (32W), step-type electroni c fan regulators, and 12" & 16" metal exhaust fans) in consonance with the existing already const ructed Multipurpose Hall /Villa Complex and other establishments already constructed as on date .The De tailed Working Structure must be in accordance to the project execution on a Turnkey basis. 10. It is highly advisable and necessary for all bidders to visit the site and upload site visit declaration duly signed & stamped by relevant forest department before quoting since the terrain is hilly and remote and r equires site specific details. Besides to ensure that the Detailed working Plan is in Consonance with the est ablishment already constructed as on date. For any Technical assistance the Bidder may contact the Divisi on office. 11. Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they do not upload any of the certificate/documents in the bid d ocuments. 12. The authority reserves all the rights to accept/reject all/any participants without assigning any reasons thereof. 13. The successful bidder (Contractor) shall execute the project on a strict turnkey basis. 14. The Performance Bank Guarantee must be submitted in the Division Office physically prior to the Tech nical Evaluation by the Bidders. Any application or invocation of the Bank Guarantee due to delays in the e xecution of works shall be governed strictly by JTC Regulation / Guideline 249.
